METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.title: Use Legendre--Poisson jets to close all scalar Long centres while retaining safe degenerations
METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.when: Opposite-weight primitive Long architectures, scalar centres and full eventual moment tails.
METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.use: ALL SCALAR LONG CENTRES NOW CLOSED IN EVERY DEGREE: for opposite nonzero weights u,v on BOTH exceptional quotients, P=(1+u)(1+v+uv) satisfies P-c EVENTUALLY PURE IFF uv=0 and c=1. The degenerate locus is one-weight or zero and SAFE against ALL original markers. Nonzero u,v force nonconstant neutral tau=1+2uv since the original algebra is a domain with only constant units. Legendre constant-term moments turn an entire shifted vanishing tail into a finite parameter jet of ell_c(L_m)=c^m. Its Cauchy function is C(s)logR+E(s), with E rational and only possible pole d=(1+c^2)/(2c). If C!=0 an unramified endpoint has residue +/-1, contradicting the proper ORIGINAL-volume UNIT retraction of AUXILIARY neutral tau. If C=0, tau-d becomes eventually pure, forbidden by its proper model. Centre0 uses a nonzero polynomial Legendre density; centres+/-1 and genuine jet cancellations are retained. EVERY torus-equivariant Bezout b of weight n+m has nonzero Y_b,F_0, so EVERY g_b-c is NOT EVEN EVENTUALLY PURE, all b degrees and ALL complex c. Primitive Long g_b differs the already closed Hopf phase. No purity reflection from nonlinear H(g_b), no exclusion of other homogeneous or mixed b, no proper model assumed for full mixed phase. Both FULL MZ cases remain OPEN at the ENTIRE exceptional pure locus corrected gluing-order vanishing or actual invariant pure failure. External review is DEFERRED and NOT the next task.
METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.avoid: Assuming every logarithm coefficient nonzero; discarding c0 or c+/-1; using finitely many moments as a full tail; assuming a proper model for a general mixed phase; reflecting nonlinear composite purity.
METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.boundary: BOTH COMPLETE exceptional MZ cases OPEN. Entire affine-centre architecture classified, NOT whole pure locus. Only auxiliary neutral height has proper model. Nonlinear composites and other/mixed weights remain. Written proof and exact finite controls, not universal machine proof or arbitrary-ring theorem.
METHOD-LEGENDRE-POISSON-JETS-AND-ALL-SCA.reopen_when: Do not search further scalar centres in this architecture. Pursue ENTIRE exceptional purity=>corrected actual gluing orders0, or actual invariant pure failure; nonlinear H and other/mixed b require new arguments. External review DEFERRED, NOT next task.
